metadata.name: hookwars_agents
metadata.description: units agent identity: passports, soulbound badges, proof levels, track records, policy wallets and diplomat bonds (docs/spec/09-agents.md).

instructions.name: apply_config
docs: Anyone applies the pending change after its eta.

instructions.name: apply_memo_config
docs: Applies proposed memo parameters after the timelock (anyone).

instructions.name: cancel_config
docs: The admin cancels the pending change.

instructions.name: commit
docs: The agent binds an accepted offer by hash.

instructions.name: endorse_attestation
docs: A registered verifier endorses the current attestation.

instructions.name: equip_badge
docs: Equips the shared Soulbound item into the badge's slot through the armory, signing as
`["armory-caller", badge_mint]` (R28: needs the armory to accept this caller).

instructions.name: freeze_policy
docs: The operator freezes or unfreezes the vault.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Creates the config, once, by this program's upgrade authority.

instructions.name: init_memo_config
docs: Creates the memo parameters, once, by the config admin.

instructions.name: init_policy
docs: The operator creates the policy.

instructions.name: issue_badge
docs: Mints the badge to the agent key once its slot holds the Soulbound item, then revokes the
mint authority.

instructions.name: link_social
docs: Links a social account: an ed25519 instruction in the same transaction signs the
statement with the agent key.

instructions.name: mark_treaty_outcome
docs: Anyone marks a ratified treaty held or broken.

instructions.name: post
docs: The agent pays postage on a message.

instructions.name: post_bond
docs: The agent posts a bond tying two treaty proposals.

instructions.name: propose_config
docs: The admin proposes a config change, applied after `admin_timelock_secs`.

instructions.name: propose_memo_config
docs: Proposes new memo parameters (applied after the admin timelock).

instructions.name: record
docs: Credits the agent: CPI only, from `["agents-caller"]` under the armory, war or items.

accounts.name: caller
docs: `["agents-caller"]` under the armory, war or items.

instructions.name: refresh_proof
docs: Anyone recomputes the proof level (expiry).

instructions.name: register_passport
docs: Registers a passport (operator and agent key sign) and creates its badge mint.

instructions.name: resolve_bond
docs: Anyone resolves a bond once its proposals are final.

instructions.name: revoke_endorsement
docs: The verifier revokes its endorsement.

instructions.name: rotate_agent_key
docs: The operator and a new key move the passport to that key; a new badge generation.

instructions.name: set_directive
docs: The operator programs its agent: a `Directive` bound by hash to a memo in this transaction,
its constraints written into the policy wallet.

accounts.name: previous
docs: The directive this one replaces (absent for sequence 0).

instructions.name: set_limits
docs: The operator changes the limits.

instructions.name: set_status
docs: The operator pauses, resumes or retires the passport.

instructions.name: spend
docs: The agent key calls an allowed program with the vault signing, within the limits.

instructions.name: submit_attestation
docs: The agent key submits (or replaces) its attestation.

instructions.name: unlink
docs: The operator or the agent key removes a link.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The operator or the agent key.

instructions.name: update_profile
docs: The operator changes the profile.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: The operator withdraws SOL (`mint` None) or a token from the vault, any time.

errors.name: MissingSignature
errors.msg: a required signature is missing

errors.name: KeyIsOperator
errors.msg: the agent key must differ from the operator

errors.name: FieldTooLong
errors.msg: a field is longer than allowed

errors.name: BadKinds

errors.name: KeyTaken

errors.name: OperatorLimit

errors.name: InsufficientFunds
errors.msg: insufficient funds

errors.name: AgentPaused

errors.name: BadLinkSignature

errors.name: BadReportData

errors.name: TtlTooLong

errors.name: NotVerifier

errors.name: NotRecorder

errors.name: BadRecordKind

errors.name: PolicyFrozen

errors.name: TargetNotAllowed

errors.name: UntrackedHolding

errors.name: TooEarly

errors.name: NotOperator

errors.name: NotAdmin

types.name: AgentKey
docs: `AgentKey` at `["agent-key", agent_key]` (09 2.3).

types.name: AgentsConfig
docs: `AgentsConfig` at `["agents-config"]` (09 2.1).

fields.name: admin
docs: Changes only behind the timelock.

fields.name: fee_collector
docs: Receives `PASSPORT_FEE_LAMPORTS`.

fields.name: soulbound_item
docs: The one shared Soulbound item (template 42) every badge equips; default until set.

fields.name: verifiers
docs: Attestation verifiers.

fields.name: targets
docs: Programs a policy vault may call.

types.name: AgentsParams
docs: Every parameter of 09 section 13 the program reads (all to set; TEST values in the suites).

fields.name: name_max_len
docs: `NAME_MAX_LEN` (at most [`NAME_CAP`]).

fields.name: uri_max_len
docs: `URI_MAX_LEN` (at most [`URI_CAP`]).

fields.name: handle_max_len
docs: `HANDLE_MAX_LEN` (at most [`HANDLE_CAP`]).

fields.name: passport_fee_lamports
docs: `PASSPORT_FEE_LAMPORTS`, to the fee collector; may be 0.

fields.name: max_passports_per_operator
docs: `MAX_PASSPORTS_PER_OPERATOR`; 0 means unlimited.

fields.name: attest_quorum
docs: `ATTEST_QUORUM`: endorsements needed for `Attested` (at least 1).

fields.name: attest_max_ttl_secs
docs: `ATTEST_MAX_TTL_SECS`.

fields.name: policy_day_secs
docs: `POLICY_DAY_SECS`.

fields.name: bond_lamports
docs: `BOND_LAMPORTS`.

fields.name: bond_min_passport_age_secs
docs: `BOND_MIN_PASSPORT_AGE_SECS`.

fields.name: bond_cancel_grace_secs
docs: `BOND_CANCEL_GRACE_SECS`.

fields.name: treaty_hold_secs
docs: `TREATY_HOLD_SECS`.

fields.name: admin_timelock_secs
docs: `ADMIN_TIMELOCK_SECS` for this program's setters (D-9).

types.name: ArmoryConfig
docs: `ArmoryConfig` at `["config"]` (02 section 2.1).

fields.name: admin
docs: Registers and retires templates, proposes params.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Proposed admin and when it may accept.

fields.name: items_minted
docs: Seed of the next item mint.

fields.name: templates
docs: Templates registered.

fields.name: params
docs: The numbers.

fields.name: item_protocol_bps
docs: Integration pass 3 (11 section 2.2, R37, E-2): the protocol's share of every token-side cut
`settle_equip` settles, taken first (`ITEM_PROTOCOL_BPS`, to set; 0 until the admin sets
it with `set_economy`). Paid to the admin's holding.

types.name: ArmoryParams
docs: Every number the armory acts on (00 section 6), set by the admin behind `admin_timelock_secs`.

fields.name: max_royalty_bps
docs: `MAX_ROYALTY_BPS`.

fields.name: vote_period_secs
docs: `VOTE_PERIOD_SECS`.

fields.name: vote_quorum_bps
docs: `VOTE_QUORUM_BPS`.

fields.name: min_notice_secs
docs: `MIN_NOTICE_SECS`.

fields.name: max_notice_secs
docs: `MAX_NOTICE_SECS`.

fields.name: forge_gain_bps
docs: `FORGE_GAIN_BPS`.

fields.name: min_twap_secs
docs: `MIN_TWAP_SECS`.

fields.name: max_pool_item_cut_bps
docs: `MAX_POOL_ITEM_CUT_BPS`: the most a Pool or Relation item may cut on one side of a swap.

fields.name: max_pool_item_discount_bps
docs: The most creator and holder fee discount an item may ask for.

fields.name: max_item_reads
docs: The most foreign accounts an item may read.

fields.name: admin_timelock_secs
docs: `ADMIN_TIMELOCK_SECS`: delay on every admin change, this one included.

fields.name: settle_bounty_bps
docs: Hookwars M3b: the bounty `settle_equip` pays its sender, of what it settles
(`MAX_CRANK_BOUNTY_BPS` at most; 04 section 2.5).

fields.name: proposal_min_bps
docs: Security review 1, M-2: the least a proposer must hold, in basis points of the mint's
supply, locked in place for the vote period (0 turns the requirement off). To set.

types.name: AttestArgs
docs: Arguments of `submit_attestation`.

types.name: Attestation
docs: `Attestation` at `["attest", passport]` (09 2.6).

fields.name: agent_key
docs: The agent key the report data binds (a rotation leaves this stale).

fields.name: endorsements
docs: Endorsements of this round.

fields.name: round
docs: Incremented on each submission; endorsements of older rounds no longer count.

types.name: Bond
docs: `Bond` at `["bond", passport, proposal_a]` (09 2.9); holds its lamports above rent.

types.name: BondMark
docs: `["bond-mark", proposal]`: a proposal is bonded at most once.

types.name: Commitment
docs: `Commitment` at `["commit", passport, ref]`.

types.name: ConfigArgs
docs: Arguments of `init_config` and `propose_config`.

types.name: ConfigChange
docs: A pending config change (applied after the timelock).

types.name: Directive
docs: `Directive` at `["directive", passport, seq]`.

fields.name: memo_hash
docs: sha256 of the memo bytes (R41).

fields.name: superseded_by
docs: The next directive's sequence, once one replaces this.

types.name: DirectiveConstraints
docs: What a directive makes the chain enforce (11 section 4.3).

fields.name: max_spend_per_action
docs: Written into `Policy.per_action_lamports`.

fields.name: max_spend_per_day
docs: Written into `Policy.per_day_lamports`.

fields.name: allowed_targets
docs: Written into `Policy.targets` (each must be allowed by the config).

fields.name: allowed_access_modes
docs: Access modes (bit per mode, 11 section 1.1) the agent may set on items it holds; read by
the armory's `set_access` (integration request).

fields.name: max_licence_price
docs: Highest licence price the agent may set; read by the armory's `set_access`.

fields.name: frozen
docs: Written into `Policy.frozen`.

types.name: Endorsement
docs: `Endorsement` at `["endorse", attestation, verifier]` (09 2.7).

fields.name: round
docs: The attestation round it endorses.

types.name: EquipConfig
docs: Targets and role chosen by the community that equips an item (04 section 2.3).

fields.name: targets
docs: Targets; their meaning is the template's.

fields.name: role
docs: 0 none; Tribute: 1 Pay, 2 Receive.

types.name: Item
docs: `Item` at `["item", item_mint]` (02 section 2.4).

fields.name: source
docs: `Authored` 0, `Loot` 1, `Forged` 2.

fields.name: has_wear
docs: Integration pass 3 (E-3): a craft `Wear` exists for this item (made at creation when its
template's `charges_on_create` is above 0); the items engine then reads it last in the
registry and answers the default while it is dormant (R38).

types.name: Link
docs: `Link` at `["link", passport, platform]` (09 2.5).

types.name: Manifest
docs: What an item may do, computed once from its template and params (04 section 2.7; 16 bytes).

fields.name: kind
docs: Slot kind.

fields.name: token_flags
docs: Token flags (upstream bits plus `ANSWERS_TOUCH`); 0 without token callbacks.

fields.name: pool_flags
docs: Pool flags; 0 without pool callbacks.

fields.name: max_cut_buy_bps
docs: Worst-case pool cut on a buy.

fields.name: max_cut_sell_bps
docs: Worst-case pool cut on a sell.

fields.name: max_cut_transfer_bps
docs: Worst-case token-side cut on a transfer.

fields.name: max_discount_bps
docs: Largest creator and holder fee discount.

fields.name: may_refuse
docs: Can fail a transfer.

fields.name: may_burn
docs: Answers a burn.

fields.name: data_bytes
docs: Range bytes used, without the epoch byte.

fields.name: reads_other_pools
docs: Foreign accounts it reads.

types.name: MemoConfig
docs: `MemoConfig` at `["memo-config"]`.

types.name: MemoParams
docs: Memo parameters (11 section 11; all to set, TEST values in the suites).

fields.name: memo_max_bytes
docs: `MEMO_MAX_BYTES`: the longest memo `set_directive` reads.

fields.name: postage_lamports
docs: `POSTAGE_LAMPORTS`: paid by `post`.

fields.name: min_proof
docs: `MEMO_MIN_PROOF`: the proof level the site shows by default (read off chain).

types.name: OperatorIndex
docs: `OperatorIndex` at `["operator", operator]` (09 2.4).

types.name: Passport
docs: `Passport` at `["passport", operator, index]` (09 2.2).

fields.name: proof
docs: Highest current level (recomputed from `links` and `attested_until`).

fields.name: links
docs: Live `Link` accounts.

fields.name: attested_until
docs: While above `now`, the proof is `Attested` (an endorsed, unexpired attestation of this key).

fields.name: badge_issued
docs: Whether the current badge has been minted to the agent key.

types.name: Policy
docs: `Policy` at `["policy", passport]` (09 2.8).

types.name: PolicyLimits
docs: Limits an operator sets.

types.name: ProfileArgs
docs: Arguments of `register_passport` and `update_profile`.

types.name: Proposal
docs: `Proposal` at `["proposal", mint, slot, nonce]` (02 section 2.8).

fields.name: item
docs: `None` empties the slot.

fields.name: config
docs: Targets and role of the equip (04 section 2.3).

fields.name: voters_open
docs: `VoteLock` accounts not yet closed (the proposal closes after them).

types.name: TrackRecord
docs: On-chain track record (09 6.1). Raids are counted by the indexer only.

types.name: TrackedLimit
docs: One tracked mint's limits in `PolicyLimits` (a struct, not a tuple, so the IDL builds; same
bytes as the former `(mint, per_action, per_day)`).

types.name: TrackedMint
docs: A tracked mint of a policy (09 2.8), in raw units.
